title: API 的錯誤格式不一致

claims.claim: tag `ep02` 的程式碼只有 `/healthz` 與 `/products` 兩條路由，沒有 API 契約檔 `api/openapi.yaml`。`internal/handler/handler.go` 出錯時呼叫 `http.Error` 回純文字，也沒有替換路由器預設的 404 與 405 回應。
claims.claim_en: The code at tag `ep02` has only the routes `/healthz` and `/products` and no API contract file `api/openapi.yaml`. On failure, `internal/handler/handler.go` calls `http.Error` and returns plain text, and it does not replace the router's default 404 and 405 responses.

claims.claim: 路由器與生成程式碼的預設回應不是 JSON。在 tag `ep03` 把替換用的函式拿掉，`TestErrorResponsesShareOneShape` 就失敗：沒有自訂的 404 時，`Content-Type` 是 `text/plain; charset=utf-8`；沒有自訂的 405 時，`Content-Type` 是空的；沒有 `ErrorHandlerFunc` 時，路徑參數格式錯誤的回應也是 `text/plain; charset=utf-8`。
claims.claim_en: The default responses of the router and of the generated code are not JSON. At tag `ep03`, remove the replacement function and `TestErrorResponsesShareOneShape` fails: without the custom 404 the `Content-Type` is `text/plain; charset=utf-8`; without the custom 405 the `Content-Type` is empty; without `ErrorHandlerFunc`, the response to a malformed path parameter is also `text/plain; charset=utf-8`.

edit.old: ErrorHandlerFunc: func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request, err error) { writeError(w, logger, err) },

claims.claim: `api/openapi.yaml` 定義 `Error`，必填欄位是 `code` 與 `message`，選填欄位是 `field`。`/products` 與 `/products/{id}` 兩個操作的 `default` 回應，都指向同一個 `Error` 回應。說明文字寫著 client 依 `code` 判斷，不依 `message`。
claims.claim_en: `api/openapi.yaml` defines `Error` with the required fields `code` and `message` and the optional field `field`. The `default` response of both operations, `/products` and `/products/{id}`, points to the same `Error` response. The description says clients switch on `code`, never on `message`.

checks.text: Clients switch on this, never on message.

claims.claim: `make api` 用固定版本 `v2.8.2` 的 `oapi-codegen`，讀 `api/openapi.yaml` 產生 `internal/api/api.gen.go`。產生的檔案有 `Error`、`Product` 與 `ServerInterface`，檔頭註解寫 `DO NOT EDIT`。`internal/handler/handler.go` 有一行 `var _ api.ServerInterface = (*server)(nil)`；把 `server` 的 `GetProduct` 方法改名後，`go build ./internal/handler` 失敗，錯誤訊息是 `missing method GetProduct`。
claims.claim_en: `make api` runs `oapi-codegen` pinned to `v2.8.2`, reads `api/openapi.yaml`, and writes `internal/api/api.gen.go`. The generated file has `Error`, `Product` and `ServerInterface`, and its header comment says `DO NOT EDIT`. `internal/handler/handler.go` has the line `var _ api.ServerInterface = (*server)(nil)`; after renaming the `GetProduct` method of `server`, `go build ./internal/handler` fails with `missing method GetProduct`.

checks.pattern: (?s)version v2\.8\.2 DO NOT EDIT\..*type Error struct \{.*type Product struct \{.*type ServerInterface interface \{

claims.claim: `internal/service/errors.go` 有一個哨兵錯誤 `ErrProductNotFound`，用 `errors.New` 建立；還有一個型別化錯誤 `ValidationError`，有 `Field` 與 `Message` 兩個欄位和一個 `Error` 方法。`ProductService.Get` 在 id 小於或等於 0 時回傳 `*ValidationError`。
claims.claim_en: `internal/service/errors.go` has a sentinel error `ErrProductNotFound`, created with `errors.New`, and a typed error `ValidationError` with the two fields `Field` and `Message` and an `Error` method. `ProductService.Get` returns a `*ValidationError` when the id is less than or equal to 0.

claims.claim: `ProductService.Get` 的回傳值最後一項是 `error`。找不到商品時，它用 `fmt.Errorf("get product %d: %w", id, ErrProductNotFound)` 包裝。把 `%w` 改成 `%v` 後，`TestProductService_Get` 失敗，訊息是 `want errors.Is`。
claims.claim_en: The last return value of `ProductService.Get` is an `error`. When the product is missing it wraps the sentinel with `fmt.Errorf("get product %d: %w", id, ErrProductNotFound)`. Change `%w` to `%v` and `TestProductService_Get` fails with `want errors.Is`.

checks.text: func (s *ProductService) Get(ctx context.Context, id int) (Product, error) {
return Product{}, fmt.Errorf("get product %d: %w", id, ErrProductNotFound)

claims.claim: `internal/handler/errors.go` 的 `writeError` 是 handler 錯誤與生成程式碼參數錯誤的出口；路由器的 404 與 405 不走這裡，由 `notFound` 與 `methodNotAllowed` 直接呼叫 `writeJSON`。它用 `errors.Is` 檢查 `ErrProductNotFound`，回 404 與 `product_not_found`；用 `errors.As` 取出 `*service.ValidationError` 與生成程式碼的三種參數錯誤，回 400 與 `invalid_request`，並把欄位名稱放進 `field`。測試 `TestErrorResponsesShareOneShape` 的 `id` 不是數字與 `id` 不是正數兩列，檢查狀態碼 400、`code` 是 `invalid_request`、`field` 是 `id`。把 `errors.Is` 換成 `==` 比較後，`TestErrorResponsesShareOneShape` 失敗，訊息是 `status = 500, want 404`。
claims.claim_en: `writeError` in `internal/handler/errors.go` is the exit for handler errors and the generated code's parameter errors; the router's 404 and 405 do not go through it, and `notFound` and `methodNotAllowed` call `writeJSON` directly. It uses `errors.Is` to check for `ErrProductNotFound` and answers 404 with `product_not_found`; it uses `errors.As` to pull out `*service.ValidationError` and the generated code's three parameter errors and answers 400 with `invalid_request`, putting the field name into `field`. In `TestErrorResponsesShareOneShape`, the rows for a non-numeric id and a non-positive id check status 400, `code` `invalid_request` and `field` `id`. Replace `errors.Is` with an `==` comparison and `TestErrorResponsesShareOneShape` fails with `status = 500, want 404`.

checks.text: status, body = http.StatusNotFound, api.Error{Code: "product_not_found", Message: "product not found"}
status, body = http.StatusBadRequest, api.Error{Code: "invalid_request", Message: validation.Message, Field: &validation.Field}
status, body = http.StatusBadRequest, api.Error{Code: "invalid_request", Message: "invalid format", Field: &badParam.ParamName}
status, body = http.StatusBadRequest, api.Error{Code: "invalid_request", Message: "is required", Field: &missing.ParamName}
status, body = http.StatusBadRequest, api.Error{Code: "invalid_request", Message: "must be given once", Field: &tooMany.ParamName}
{"id is not a number (generated binder)", http.MethodGet, "/products/abc", fakeProducts{}, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "id"},

{"id is not positive (service validation)", http.MethodGet, "/products/0", fakeProducts{err: &service.ValidationError{Field: "id", Message: "must be a positive integer"}}, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "id"},

claims.claim: `writeError` 遇到不認得的錯誤，把原因寫進 log，回給 client 的只有 `internal_error` 與 `internal error`。把回應訊息改成原始錯誤文字後，`TestErrorResponsesShareOneShape` 失敗，訊息是 `message leaks internals`。
claims.claim_en: When `writeError` meets an error it does not recognise, it logs the cause and the client receives only `internal_error` and `internal error`. Change the response message to the raw error text and `TestErrorResponsesShareOneShape` fails with `message leaks internals`.

claims.claim: tag `ep03` 的 `internal/handler` 套件沒有任何 `http.Error` 呼叫。`ListProducts` 與 `GetProduct` 出錯時都呼叫 `writeError`。路由器的 404 與 405 換成 `notFound` 與 `methodNotAllowed`，兩者回傳 `http.HandlerFunc`，寫出的 body 是 `api.Error` 的 JSON，並直接呼叫 `writeJSON`。生成程式碼的 `ErrorHandlerFunc` 也呼叫 `writeError`。
claims.claim_en: The `internal/handler` package at tag `ep03` has no `http.Error` call. `ListProducts` and `GetProduct` call `writeError` on failure. The router's 404 and 405 are replaced by `notFound` and `methodNotAllowed`, which return an `http.HandlerFunc`; the body it writes is the JSON of `api.Error`, and it calls `writeJSON` directly. The generated code's `ErrorHandlerFunc` also calls `writeError`.

checks.text: ErrorHandlerFunc: func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request, err error) { writeError(w, logger, err) },
writeJSON(w, logger, http.StatusNotFound, api.Error{Code: "route_not_found", Message: "no such route"})
writeJSON(w, logger, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, api.Error{Code: "method_not_allowed", Message: "method not allowed"})

claims.claim: 測試 `TestErrorResponsesShareOneShape` 有 8 列，每列是一種出錯情況：商品不存在、包了兩層的商品不存在、id 不是數字、id 不是正數、列表出錯、單筆出錯、路由不存在、方法不對。每一列都檢查 `Content-Type` 是 JSON、body 能解成沒有多餘欄位的 `api.Error`、`code` 符合預期、`field` 符合預期，`message` 不是空的也不含 `postgres`；方法不對那一列另外檢查 `Allow` 標頭是 `GET`。這個測試通過。
claims.claim_en: The test `TestErrorResponsesShareOneShape` has 8 rows, one per failure: unknown product, a not-found wrapped twice, an id that is not a number, an id that is not positive, a failing list, a failing get, an unknown route and a wrong method. Every row checks that `Content-Type` is JSON, that the body decodes into `api.Error` with no extra fields, that `code` is as expected, that `field` is as expected, and that `message` is not empty and does not contain `postgres`; the wrong-method row also checks that the `Allow` header is `GET`. The test passes.

claims.claim: `/healthz` 不在 `api/openapi.yaml` 裡。它的 handler 回 200 和純文字 `ok`。
claims.claim_en: `/healthz` is not in `api/openapi.yaml`. Its handler answers 200 with the plain text `ok`.

claims.claim: Go 的函式用最後一個回傳值 `error` 回報失敗，呼叫端自己檢查。C# 用 `throw` 丟出例外，由外層的 `catch` 或例外處理器接住。Java 的 checked exception 要在方法簽名用 `throws` 宣告，或在呼叫端接住。
claims.claim_en: A Go function reports failure through a last return value of type `error`, and the caller checks it. C# raises an exception with `throw`, caught by an outer `catch` or exception handler. A Java checked exception must be declared with `throws` in the method signature or caught by the caller.
